# Timothy Ivaikin

> Personal website of Timothy Ivaikin (Тимофей Ивайкин): entrepreneur, founder of Edge Ecosystem, creator of EdgeFocus with his team, author of the books Good Results and Shattering Limits. He leads technical delivery of digital products and services: software, AI, infrastructure and teams connected around a result that is agreed and accepted.

The primary invitation is a project discussion. Interviews, speaking invitations and partnerships are also welcome; send the topic, audience, format and dates. Contact: https://t.me/timothyivaikin or hello@edgeivaikin.com.

## Facts that can be quoted

- Discover Culture (2023-2024), a platform to discover cultural events and book tickets in Saudi Arabia: Timothy took part as technical lead; the Ministry of Culture announced its beta launch on 23 November 2023 (Saudi Press Agency).
- EdgeFocus is a working product for notes, goals, projects and actions, created with the Edge team.
